notes.title: Patch 06/02/2023 - V1.1.0
notes.notes:
Please find below the patch notes for today's patch v1.1.0 

Bug Fix: Fixed a bug when using the March order on a region with a power token.

Branding: Several small text corrections

notes.title: A little bird told me of a new patch!
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow members of the seven Great Houses,

We gather here today to discuss the coming of a new patch for Westeros, a guiding light in our objective to bring about a greater life for all those that live within the Seven Kingdoms. Please read on as to discover what awaits you the next time you venture through these lands and wage war for the coveted Iron Throne:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/bc4b4e9cf7514a3755fe598b14b5fdf272ff908f.png

Patch Notes:

Bug Fixes:

Soft Lock - If an AI gained its seventh castle through battle for a neutral territory, the game would soft lock.
Soft Lock - If a player denied support to an AI attacking neutral territory, the AI will get stuck in a support request loop
Cards: Patchface would not remove the last card in hand correctly
Rules: If a house is moved to last on the Iron Throne track through Doran Martell, their turn can be skipped
Rules: Several rule fixes and clarifications made
Ports: If a port was made uncontrolled due to card effects, ships would not be correctly dealt with
Chat: he first letter of chat messages was frequently missed or dropped
Main Menu: The "Quit Game" prompt would stack if "escape" was hit repeatedly in the main menu
Lobby Matches: Live games would not give a prompt when saving and exiting
UI: Wildling Track details were hidden by influence track bidding
UI: Combat prompts would not progress if you panned away from battle
UI: Battle Prompting would not display in southern areas of the map at two zoom levels
UI: Battle Values would not be visible as Martel when attacking Tyrell from East to West Summer Sea

New Features:

Tooltips have been updated

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/bc4b4e9cf7514a3755fe598b14b5fdf272ff908f.png

To everyone who has reported bugs, provided details, given feedback; we want to offer our greatest thanks possible and assure you that our improvements and changes for A Game of Thrones: The Board Game - Digital Edition have not stopped. We are already working on a new patch to address further concerns of the community and will communicate more on this in the future.

Thank you and may the gods you worship bring you favor in battle and triumph in war!
